images.name: surge-addicts
images.joke: CHEESE AND CRACKERS! I FEEL FREAKING GREEEEEEAT!!!!
images.alt: A TrainingPeaks file from SBT GRVL (7:15:37, 145 mi, 455 TSS) with a spiky power graph; cartoon Gravel God pulls a wheelie across it shouting: "CHEESE AND CRACKERS! I FEEL FREAKING GREEEEEEAT!!!!"
Panel 1: cartoon Gravel God charges straight at the camera on a gravel road, a dust cloud behind him. Caption: "WHAT CHAIN?"
Panel 2: cartoon Gravel God stands straddling his stopped bike on the gravel road, smiling. Caption: "NOT PEDALING FEELS NICE."

images.joke: 3 / WHY DA F DO I DO THIS?
images.alt: Panel 3: cartoon Gravel God sits slumped in the gravel by the roadside, grimacing. Caption: "WHY DA F DO I DO THIS?"
images.note: The old panel showed him crashed head-first with legs in the air; the rig has no crash pose, so he sits slumped in the gravel.
